status: Bounded sampled investigation; neither mode can prove absence of a continuous escape path.
solids: 4mm extruded polygon720 outer profile R143 + .25*cos(3*(theta-pi/3)), inner circle R135; guide root R9, lip R11, width10, groove4.4. OpenCascade intersections are exact for these modeled BReps subject to numeric tolerances; smooth lobed shape is approximated.

fixed_DOF: in-plane rotation about Y / shape phase
domain.neighbors: six axis-adjacent neighbors; midpoint checked for each admitted edge

tracking_assumption: Approximate translation following: upper shift = initial closed shift + vertical lift. Pitch-dependent tracking, contact loss and forces are not solved. Hard stops +/-1mm. This is a restrictive kinematic assumption, not real follower dynamics.
stuck_assumption: Upper follower fixed at +1mm; lower guides fixed.

collision_classification.intermediate: uncertain and excluded from reachable component

escape_endpoint: Track Y bounds fully beyond guide flange slab by .1mm: ymax<−5.1 or ymin>+5.1. This is only a track-subset endpoint.
omitted: other pose domains and coupled rotations
validation_note: Search guide BRep was compared against the previous nominal FreeCAD guide under translation: equal volumes and zero bidirectional difference volumes within 1e-6 mm3. Four saved search solids reopened valid.
review_note: Independent review checked pose transform, guide dimensions and same-polygon initial solve. First uncertain obstacle short-circuits classification; conservative rejection, not exhaustive collision diagnosis. No uncertain poses occurred in this run.
